scope: Eight actual stiffness/load/asymmetric-pad cases compare rigid, diagonal and coupled free-link compliance at centroid and degree6 quadrature:48 full fields,32 model contrasts and24 separate sampling contrasts. Coupled pressure satisfies its complete elastic pad law; approximate models retain their measured full-law residuals. Independent full-elastic fixed-point and split-source controls agree with the condensed solution, and an actual1mm search misses compression before expanding to3mm. The nominal rigid approximation is close, while flexible-link/stiff-pad pressure and field errors reach24.47% and6.68%; diagonal compliance barely improves them. Contact sampling itself changes coupled full stress by1.94–2.82%, and remains distinct from model error. Six-panel pressure maps pass direct rendered review and exact183x142mm export checks. Operators and full arrays stay on data. This is one coarse linear-elastic geometry with static normal pads; thickness, changing nonconvex/friction histories, continuum qualification, production native integration and incremental measured throughput remain required.
